christmaspresents.menu.wrap.tip: Closes the present. Only the player named on the tag can open it, or anyone if you leave the name empty.
christmaspresents.tooltip.unwrapped: Not wrapped yet: place it and right-click to wrap
christmaspresents.wait: No peeking! %s more days until Christmas.
christmaspresents.config.enabled.desc: Turns Christmas Presents on or off. Presents stay where they are either way.
christmaspresents.config.onlyOnChristmas: Presents can only be opened from December 24 to 26 (the server's date). Until then, opening one says how many days are left.
christmaspresents.config.anyoneCanOpen.d: Anyone can open any present, not only the player whose name is on it.
christmaspresents.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
